title: A Fan, a Jug and a Mug
lines: Max is in bed and a big fan hums.
But a fan quits and Max hops up.
"The fan is bad!" said Max. He is mad.
Dad pats it. It hums, but it quits.
Dad tips a jug and gets a cup.
Max sips. Dad gets a red cap.
Dad fans him, and Max hugs him and naps.
scoring_note: This passage says "he is". Decodability forbids apostrophes. A child who reads "he's" is reading for meaning — do not score it an error.
